restatement_markers: should no longer be relied upon

sections.title: Business
sections.text: The Company designs and sells industrial sensors across three regions. Fiscal 2024 saw stable demand. The Company operates one manufacturing facility.

sections.title: Risk Factors - Interest Rate Risk
sections.text: Rising interest rates could increase our borrowing costs and reduce demand for financed purchases.

sections.title: Management Discussion and Analysis
sections.text: Revenue grew modestly during the period. Liquidity remained adequate and we relied on operating cash flow to fund capital expenditure.

sections.title: Financial Statements
sections.text: Net income was reported in accordance with GAAP for the periods presented.

sections.title: Business
sections.text: The Company designs and sells industrial sensors across four regions. Fiscal 2025 saw expanding demand and a new product line. The Company operates two manufacturing facilities.

sections.title: Risk Factors - Interest Rate Risk
sections.text: Rising interest rates could increase our borrowing costs, reduce demand for financed purchases, and raise refinancing risk on near-term maturities.

sections.title: Risk Factors - Cybersecurity Incident
sections.text: A cybersecurity incident could disrupt operations, expose customer data, and harm our reputation.

sections.title: Management Discussion and Analysis
sections.text: Following an internal review, we have restated our previously issued financial statements for fiscal 2024, and those statements should no longer be relied upon. Liquidity remained adequate during the period.

sections.title: Financial Statements
sections.text: Net income was reported in accordance with GAAP for the periods presented, as revised.
